title: Create a Book Model
description: Define a Book model with title, author, published_year, and isbn fields. Then create and apply migrations.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

In a Django app named `library`, create a model called `Book` with the following fields:
- `title` (CharField, max_length=200)
- `author` (CharField, max_length=100)
- `published_year` (IntegerField)
- `isbn` (CharField, max_length=13, unique=True)

After defining the model, run the appropriate commands to create and apply the migration.

> **Hint**: Remember to add the app to `INSTALLED_APPS` before running migrations.
hints: Add the app to INSTALLED_APPS in settings.py if you haven't already.
Run `python manage.py makemigrations` to generate the migration.
Run `python manage.py migrate` to create the table.
Check your database (db.sqlite3) to see if the table was created.
expectedOutput: When you run `python manage.py showmigrations`, you should see `[X] library` (or your app name) with a migration marked as applied.
solutionCode:
# library/models.py
from django.db import models

class Book(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    author = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    published_year = models.IntegerField()
    isbn = models.CharField(max_length=13, unique=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.title

# Then in terminal:
# python manage.py makemigrations
# python manage.py migrate
